outcome: procedural pain (measured by Neonatal Infant Pain Scale - NIPS scores)
cohort: A total of 957 neonates in a tertiary NICU and two level-two neonatal care units were included in the study, exposed to 15 common clinical painful procedures.
finding: Neonatal pain response to clinical procedures in the NICU followed a certain pattern, with procedures categorized into severe pain (NIPS 5-7), mild to moderate pain (NIPS 3-4), and no pain to mild pain (NIPS 0-2) based on the Neonatal Infant Pain Scale scores.
